blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The municipal government of Mansalay in Oriental Mindoro suspended all nonreligious activities for its town fiesta on Nov. 24 and 25 as a precautionary measure against the possible effects of a looming Super El Niño. Under Memorandum Order No. 227, series of 2026, Mayor Ferdinand Maliwanag ordered the cancellation of nonreligious activities and programs during the two-day celebration, according to an announcement from the municipal government’s information office on Sunday, Nov. 15. Religious activities and related celebrations will continue as scheduled in recognition of the faith and traditions of the community. READ: El Niño takes toll […]...
